title: Watch Out for Your Agents! Investigating Backdoor Threats to LLM-Based Agents

layout.note: A query banner and a dashed key row on top; below, four stacked lanes (one per agent) share the same four columns Thought, Action, Observation, Output with column heads above; thick blue arrows join the last three columns.

lesson: Run one concrete query through aligned lanes, one per variant, with identical typed columns so that the only differences are red-marked spans; reserve red for the attacker's trigger and effects and use a green verdict for the correct result.
